1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronCutTreeCurvature
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.VertexFanCutTreeConeCoverage
3 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronJunctionAngleSum
4 
5 /-! The source-angle budget for the six-vertex universal-source case.
6 Local cone coverage, flat junction sums, and the global curvature bound
7 all come from the actual polyhedron, with no canonical graph assumption. -/
8 
9 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
10 
11 open Set Real
12 
13 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} [Fintype P.Face]
14   (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
15   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
16     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
17   {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
18   [Fintype T.vertices] [DecidableRel T.graph.Adj]
19   (models : (d : T.graph.Dart) → CutEdgeMetricModel T d.adj)
20 
21 include size small_faces in
22 /-- The original face-angle sum is bounded by all actual incident tree triangles. -/
23 theorem small_incident_angles_cover_surfaceAngle (u : T.vertices) (v : P.Vertex)
24     (at_vertex : (u : Space) = (v : Space)) :
25     P.surfaceAngle v ≤ T.incidentAngleSum models u := by
26   have degree := P.edgeGraph_min_degree v
27   letI : NeZero (P.edgeGraph.degree v) := ⟨by omega⟩
28   obtain ⟨fan⟩ := P.exists_vertex_face_fan size small_faces v rfl
29   rw [← fan.totalAngle_eq_surfaceAngle size small_faces]
30   exact fan.incident_model_angles_cover_cone size small_faces a T models u at_vertex
31 
32 include size small_faces in
33 /-- Tree angle accounting needs only a total-curvature upper bound. -/
34 theorem small_source_angle_sum_le_of_curvature_bound
35     (curvature_bound : (∑ v : P.Vertex, P.vertexCurvature v) ≤ 4 * π)
36     (source : P.Vertex) (at_source : (a : Space) = (source : Space)) :
37     (∑ d, (models d).sourceAngle) ≤ P.surfaceAngle source := by
38   classical
39   have at_vertex (u : T.vertices) :
40       2 * π - T.originalCurvature u ≤ T.incidentAngleSum models u := by
41     by_cases original : (u : Space) ∈ P.vertices
42     · let v : P.Vertex := ⟨u, original⟩
43       rw [T.originalCurvature_at_vertex u v rfl, vertexCurvature, sub_sub_cancel]
44       exact small_incident_angles_cover_surfaceAngle size small_faces T models u v rfl
45     · rw [T.originalCurvature_at_nonvertex u original, sub_zero]
46       exact (small_sum_nonvertex_junction_angles size small_faces a T u original
47         (fun v => models (T.graph.dartOfNeighborSet u v))).ge
48   have total := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun u (_ : u ∈ Finset.univ) => at_vertex u)
49   rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, T.sum_originalCurvature source at_source] at total
50   simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul] at total
51   rw [show P.vertexCurvature source = 2 * π - P.surfaceAngle source from rfl] at total
52   have accounting := T.sum_source_and_vertex_angles models
53   linarith
54 
55 include small_faces in
56 /-- The complete source-angle budget for six vertices and a universal source. -/
57 theorem universal_source_angle_sum_le (six : P.vertices.card = 6)
58     (source : P.Vertex) (universal : ∀ v : P.Vertex, v ≠ source → P.edgeGraph.Adj source v)
59     (at_source : (a : Space) = (source : Space)) :
60     (∑ d, (models d).sourceAngle) ≤ P.surfaceAngle source :=
61   small_source_angle_sum_le_of_curvature_bound (by omega) small_faces T models
62     (universal_sum_vertexCurvature_le six small_faces source universal) source at_source
63 
64 include small_faces in
65 /-- Each kite is counted twice by the directed sum; the half-sum is strictly below π. -/
66 theorem universal_half_source_angle_sum_lt_pi (six : P.vertices.card = 6)
67     (source : P.Vertex) (universal : ∀ v : P.Vertex, v ≠ source → P.edgeGraph.Adj source v)
68     (at_source : (a : Space) = (source : Space)) :
69     (∑ d, (models d).sourceAngle) / 2 < π := by
70   have bound := universal_source_angle_sum_le small_faces T models six source universal at_source
71   have strict := surfaceAngle_lt_two_pi (show P.vertices.card ≤ 6 by omega) small_faces source
72   linarith
73 
74 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
